description: Published vector values that changed between mvp-0.2-baseline.6 and mvp-0.2-baseline.7, each with the decision that approved it. Checked by scripts/check-baseline-changes.mjs; any other changed or removed value fails validation.

changed.rule: Orchestrator decision (2026-10-11, finding C1 of the differential fuzzing), SHARED-SECTIONS-PROFILE-01 §14.1: a refused change is named only when its bytes are one type 1 change chunk of exact length whose checksum matches. SS45's chunk has a wrong checksum, so its old name was the hash of its intact copy, and a receiver that remembered the refusal by that name refused the intact copy when it came. The refusal and its diagnostic are unchanged; the change field is removed.
